# e2b_api_key (Resource)

Manages an E2B team API key. This route requires `access_token` and `team_id` provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "e2b_api_key" "ci" {
  name = "terraform-ci"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) API key name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the API key was created.
- `created_by_email` (String) Email address that created the API key, when returned by E2B.
- `created_by_id` (String) User ID that created the API key, when returned by E2B.
- `id` (String) API key ID.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Raw API key value. E2B only returns this value at creation time.
- `last_used` (String) Timestamp when the API key was last used, when returned by E2B.
- `mask_prefix` (String) Token type prefix in E2B's masked key metadata.
- `mask_value_length` (Number) Original token length in E2B's masked key metadata.
- `masked_value_prefix` (String) Visible prefix in E2B's masked key metadata.
- `masked_value_suffix` (String) Visible suffix in E2B's masked key metadata.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import e2b_api_key.ci key_123
```
